svg.aria-label: Measured on six open bugs in a 1M-line TypeScript repo: five fixed and proven, one correctly not reproduced, 64 scripts with 0 failures, 87% of the data scripts touched never reached the model, $1.15 for all six with Opus 5.5.

text.font-family: 'Instrument Sans', Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Every run reproduces first, then proves the fix.
